verdict.rationale: Whether a product's source is available under an open license is a fair question for a SaaS spend-management platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no first-party statement that Brex's source is published under any open license. The only code-related item is a community-supported TypeScript client library developed by a third party (Maroo), which is not Brex's own source and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
